entities.summary: Kari Markus Granlund is a Finnish professional ice hockey forward who is currently playing with Genève-Servette HC of the National League (NL). He is a second-round selection of the Calgary Flames, taken 45th overall at the 2011 NHL entry draft. Granlund played two seasons in the SM-liiga for HIFK before moving to North America to join the Flames organization in 2013. His older brother Mikael plays in the NHL for the Anaheim Ducks.
